culpritSource.quote: Conan investigates and realizes it's a murder. After tranquilizing Kogoro, he reveals the culprit is Kazuyuki Kawai. He tells that when Kawai and Yamazaki were alone on the deck, while Yamazaki wasn't looking, Kawai attached the cutter knife-edge. Then, he attached the hook on the hull, and pretended that a big fish was pulling hard on the rod. Asking Yamazaki for help, he had Yamazaki grab onto his fishing rod, and used the cutter knife-edge to cut the line. He made the fishing rod to touch the electric wire, killing Yamazaki.

motive.quote: Kawai confesses and revealed Yamazaki loaned him money with high interest, and tried to take over his company.

motive.zhHans: Kawai 供认，并揭示山崎以高利借钱给他，还企图吞掉他的公司。此外，由于山崎是这笔债务的担保人，Kawai 不得不把他指定为自己寿险的受益人，赔付额很高。
motive.en: Kawai confesses and revealed Yamazaki loaned him money with high interest, and tried to take over his company. In addition, as Yamazaki was the guarantor for this debt, Kawai had to make him the beneficiary of his life insurance with a large payout.

method.zhHans: 接着，他把钩子挂在船身上，装作有大鱼在猛烈拉扯鱼竿。他叫山崎帮忙，让山崎抓住自己的鱼竿，再用美工刀的刀刃割断鱼线。拿这些东西来钓鱼看起来很不寻常，但 Kawai 声称自己只是把它们带在身上，并说那仍然是意外。事情发生时他正在烧电线：他用打火机熔化橡胶外皮，让电线裸露出来，结果乙烯树脂落到了灯芯上。随后他保持跌落的姿态，脱下靴子扔掉，把橡胶手套藏进口袋，装作昏迷。
method.en: Then, he attached the hook on the hull, and pretended that a big fish was pulling hard on the rod. Asking Yamazaki for help, he had Yamazaki grab onto his fishing rod, and used the cutter knife-edge to cut the line. Using those for fishing seems pretty unusual, but Kawai claims he only had them in his, and that the death was still an accident. It happened when he was burning the electric wire: he used the lighter to melt the rubber coating leaving the electric wire exposed, causing the vinyl to fall onto the wick. Then, by keeping a falling pose, he took the boots off and threw them away, hid the rubber gloves in his pocket, and pretended to be unconscious.

evidence.zhHans: Kawai 仍坚持说自己不是犯人，并要求拿出确凿证据。小五郎解释说，确凿证据就是 Kawai 的打火机。Kawai 供认，并揭示山崎以高利借钱给他，还企图吞掉他的公司。
evidence.en: Kawai continues to say that he's not the culprit and demands solid evidence. Kogoro explains that the solid evidence is Kawai's lighter. Kawai confesses and revealed Yamazaki loaned him money with high interest, and tried to take over his company.

resolution.zhHans: 柯南调查后意识到这是一起谋杀。麻醉小五郎之后，他指出犯人是 Kazuyuki Kawai。他说，当 Kawai 和山崎两人单独在甲板上时，趁山崎没注意，Kawai 装上了美工刀的刀刃。接着，他把钩子挂在船身上，装作有大鱼在猛烈拉扯鱼竿。他叫山崎帮忙，让山崎抓住自己的鱼竿，再用美工刀的刀刃割断鱼线。他让鱼竿碰到电线，电死了山崎。Kawai 试图否认，声称那样他自己也会死。小五郎说，如果他像山崎一样徒手赤脚，确实会。随后他要求查看 Kawai 的口袋，里面是肤色的橡胶手套。拿这些东西来钓鱼看起来很不寻常，但 Kawai 声称自己只是把它们带在身上，并说那仍然是意外。
resolution.en: Conan investigates and realizes it's a murder. After tranquilizing Kogoro, he reveals the culprit is Kazuyuki Kawai. He tells that when Kawai and Yamazaki were alone on the deck, while Yamazaki wasn't looking, Kawai attached the cutter knife-edge. Then, he attached the hook on the hull, and pretended that a big fish was pulling hard on the rod. Asking Yamazaki for help, he had Yamazaki grab onto his fishing rod, and used the cutter knife-edge to cut the line. He made the fishing rod to touch the electric wire, killing Yamazaki. Kawai tries to deny it, claiming that he would have died too. Kogoro says, he would have, if he was bare handed and bare footed like Yamazaki. Then he ask to show what's inside in his pocket and it was skin colored rubber gloves. Using those for fishing seems pretty unusual, but Kawai claims he only had them in his, and that the death was still an accident.

summary.en:
Kazuyuki Kawai invites Kogoro, Ran, and Conan to his houseboat for dinner and to view the fireworks. During the fireworks, Kawai's guest, Tsuneo Yamazaki, is found dead.

Location: Unabara Boat

Victim: Tsuneo Yamazaki
